name: @hraness/graphics
description: Graphics is a headless CLI and Agent Skill for deterministic diagrams, local agent tools, tldraw interchange, and measured raster-to-SVG vectorization.

scripts.build: bun -e 'await (await import("node:fs/promises")).rm("./dist", { recursive: true, force: true })' && bun build ./src/cli.ts --outfile ./dist/cli.js --target bun --format esm --packages external && bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.js --target bun --format esm --packages external && bun build ./src/vectorize/worker.ts --outfile ./dist/vectorize-worker.js --target bun --format esm --packages external && tsc --project ./tsconfig.build.json && bun run ./scripts/build-types.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run check:schema && bun run test && bun run build && bun run check:skill && bun run test:package
